props.name: attack-technique

metadata.remarks: Cloud Configuration and Posture defines the trust properties required to ensure cloud environments remain in an intended secure state over time. This pattern addresses the reality that cloud compromise frequently arises from configuration drift or misalignment rather than software flaws.

components.title: Configuration Baseline Definition
components.description: Establishes intended secure configuration baselines for cloud resources.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cloud configurations are defined against approved security baselines.

components.title: Configuration Drift Detection
components.description: Detects deviations from approved cloud configuration baselines.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Deviations from intended cloud configuration state are detected and surfaced.

components.title: Posture Visibility and Reporting
components.description: Provides visibility into cloud security posture for governance and risk decisions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Cloud security posture is observable and reportable to relevant stakeholders.
